services.name: Youth / School Tours
services.desc: The National Railroad Museum offers two youth / school tours of the Museum that educate students on the history of railroads. During the tours, discussions are supplemented with hands-on activities and tours of various locomotives and rail cars. In addition, the Museum offers an array of specialized programs; details regarding each of those programs is available on other pages in the Education section of our website. This guided program, designed for students in pre-K through 8th grade (ages 8-14), offers an interactive experience that introduces students to trains and railroading. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Picture your celebration surrounded by locomotives that have carried presidents, powered a nation, and outlasted a century - set against the banks of the Fox River in Green Bay, Wisconsin. It’s a backdrop your guests won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re planning an intimate micro-wedding or a large-scale gathering for hundreds, the National Railroad Museum offers a setting your guests will be talking about long after the day is over. From weddings to milestone birthdays to corporate events and celebrations of every kind, we have a space built for it - and an Events team that will help you bring it to life.
